prompts.idle:
Use case: identity-preserve. Deliverable: ONE production-ready square 2D RPG animation sprite sheet, actual transparent PNG. Primary reference Image 1 locks character identity, face and costume; Image 2 is motion inspiration ONLY, never copy its labels or sheet layout. This is Gia Cát Lượng / Zhuge Liang: gold/yellow flowing scholar robes, ivory skirt, red-and-gold shoulder mantle, red sash and ribbons, tall cylindrical patterned gold crown, black moustache and pointed long goatee, red-orange/gold feather fan. Match the hand-painted 2D style of Image 1 precisely. Always face screen RIGHT.
STRICT GRID: the whole square canvas is divided into exactly 3 equally wide columns and 3 equally tall rows, making 9 IDENTICAL square cells. Read row-major. Put ONE full-body pose in each of the FIRST EIGHT cells; keep the ninth/bottom-right cell completely transparent. No visible grid lines, text, arrows, frame numbers, captions, borders, checkerboard or background. No character or ribbon may cross a cell boundary. Keep 8% transparent padding INSIDE every cell. Same scale, camera, costume, head size and boot-ground baseline in all cells. Center the midpoint of the boot soles at 50% cell width and 89% cell height. Crown stays near 10% cell height. Both boots visible. Maintain consistent hand anatomy and fan. Do not duplicate the same image; these are eight distinct ordered animation drawings. No baked shadows, rune platforms, sparks, smoke or external VFX. Pure alpha transparency outside characters. Square high-resolution sheet.
ANIMATION: Eight-frame seamless IDLE loop. Feet anchored, head and crown steady. Gentle breathing, tiny shoulder/chest lift, small changing fan tilt, beard and long ribbons sway left/right in a smooth cycle. Frames 1-2: relaxed and begin inhale. 3-4: inhale crest, fan slightly lifted. 5-6: exhale, ribbons drift back. 7-8: return to relaxed pose, last blends into first. Only subtle animation, no attack gestures or glow.
